IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Thursday 12 November
Winds: East to southeasterly below 10 knots tending south to southeasterly 15 to 20 knots in the early afternoon then tending south to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre around midday.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 13 November
Winds: West to northwesterly below 10 knots becoming southwesterly in the early morning then becoming east to southeasterly in the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Saturday 14 November
Winds: Southeast to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots becoming westerly about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Sunday 15 November
Winds: West to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots turning southwesterly 20 to 30 knots during the morning then becoming westerly about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A ridge of high pressure strengthens from the west today. This ridge is expected to persist until Friday before it is eroded by a weak trough developing over the state. This trough is forecast to weaken on Saturday before a cold front moves over the state during the day. Cool southwesterly winds are forecast on Sunday as a high approaches from the west in the evening.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Thursday 12 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots, reaching up to 25 knots inshore in the evening.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres.
Weather: Cloudy.

Friday 13 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots, reaching up to 20 knots near Cape Bruny early in the morning. Winds becoming variable about 10 knots in the middle of the day.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2 metres inshore, increasing to 2 to 3 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Saturday 14 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming west to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots during the morning then becoming westerly 20 to 30 knots during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.
IDT12326.synoptic: A ridge of high pressure strengthens from the west today. This ridge is expected to persist until Friday before it is eroded by a weak trough developing over the state. This trough is forecast to weaken on Saturday before a cold front moves over the state during the day. Cool southwesterly winds are forecast on Sunday as a high approaches from the west in the evening.
